latestVersion.changelog:
Major update: Streamlines the product iteration design process with a screenshot-driven, 4-step approach.

- Reduced from 7-step to 4-step workflow for faster, more focused iterations.
- Introduced interface screenshots as mandatory anchor points for precise specification and changes.
- Categorized modifications by type (add/modify/delete) with tailored data collection for each.
- Outputs are now exclusively delta PRD and an updated prototype with before/after comparisons.
- Obsolete and redundant reference files removed; new step and template references added for clarity.
